title: DNA Gel Electrophoresis
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7pshmne
materials: P product DNA Gel Loading Dye
Visualize band under blue light transilluminator

steps.title: Prepare loading dye mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL of 6X loading dye (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #R0611) with 50 µL of PCR product DNA.

steps.title: Load sample onto gel
steps.instruction: Mix the combined sample thoroughly and load the entire volume into wells of a 1 % agarose gel.

steps.title: Load DNA ladder
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of a 1 kb or 100 bp DNA ladder to a separate well of the gel.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 120 V for 20 minutes (00:20:00).
